description: Run JavaScript on the robot with the `rover` library (same as the Code page; it replaces any running program and starts the simulation). Top-level await works. Motion (await): rover.forward(s), backward(s), turn(deg), left(s), right(s); rover.drive(speed −1…1, turn °/s) keeps going; rover.stop(); rover.power(%). Readings (sync, 50 ms snapshots): rover.read(id), sensors(), distance() (nearest sonar/IR cm), light() (%), bumped(), pose(), time(). Head/face: await rover.head(deg), trackLight(on), headAngle(); rover.face(emotion, text), say(text, s). Buttons: pressed(id), onButton([id], fn(event)), await waitButton([id]). Time/output: await wait(s), await rover.until(fn, timeout), log(...). Customise: await rover.module(name, on), addSensor({type,name,x,y,angle,range}), updateSensor(id, fields), removeSensor(id), sensorList(). Returns immediately; poll get_program for status and the console.
name: run_program
title: Run a rover program
